name: Custom Guest Authors
author: Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi

sections.description:
The Custom Guest Authors plugin allows setting custom guest author names or multiple guest author names for posts using a custom field named guest-author. For multiple authors, separate the names with commas. Ideal for blog owners with multiple guest contributors but don’t want separate WordPress user accounts for each. This plugin was inspired by a tutorial from WPBeginner.

Future Plans for Enhancement

  1. Support for custom post types.
  2. Option to specify a default guest author in settings.
  3. Shortcode support for displaying guest authors in custom places.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the custom-guest-authors directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the guest-author custom field in posts to specify custom guest authors.
sections.faq:
Can I use this for custom post types?

Not currently. But support for custom post types is planned for future releases.

How do I set custom guest authors for a post?

Edit a post and add a custom field named ‘guest-author’. For one author, add their name. For multiple authors, use commas to separate names, e.g., “John Doe, Jane Smith”.
